# Rivera Welding

> Welding, muffler & auto mechanic shop based in Austin, Texas. A no-nonsense East Austin shop at 5211 Manor Rd. Exhaust and muffler work, broken welds, rims, custom fabrication and everyday repairs. Call, tell us what's going on, and get a straight answer.

## Services
- Mufflers & exhaust: New mufflers, pipes and complete exhaust work. We fabricate or install, and sell parts to the public.
- Welding & fabrication: Welding is in our name. Cracked rims, broken brackets, trailers and custom metal work.
- Mechanic work: Everyday repairs and diagnostics on cars and trucks, from engine trouble to transmission work.

## About
Rivera Welding is the welding, muffler and auto mechanic shop at 5211 Manor Rd in East Austin. Our banner says it in two languages: servicing Austin for over 20 years, sirviendo a Austin por más de 20 años. Exhaust and welding are the core of the work: mufflers, pipes, broken exhaust welds, cracked rims and custom metal pieces. As our invoice book puts it, fabricamos o instalamos, y se venden al público: we fabricate or install, and we sell to the public. We also take on general mechanic work for cars, trucks and trailers. The Better Business Bureau lists us as Rivera Welding Auto Mechanics and Muffler Shop, with an A+ rating. We're a neighborhood shop, and neighbors send people our way. One customer came to us on a recommendation from Leal's down the road to get a rim welded, and said it made her feel like part of a community here in East Austin.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Can you weld a cracked or bent rim?
  A: Yes. Bring the wheel or the car to 5211 Manor Rd and we'll take a look. Call (512) 386-6211 first if you want to check timing.
- Q: Do you fix broken exhaust welds and mufflers?
  A: Yes. Exhaust and muffler work is a big part of what we do, from re-welding a broken joint to a new muffler or pipes. We'll tell you the price before we start.
- Q: Do you make custom parts?
  A: Yes. We fabricate or install, and we sell to the public. Tell us what you need and we'll tell you if we can build it.
- Q: Is there a charge to diagnose my car?
  A: For mechanic problems that need diagnosis, there can be a diagnostic fee. Ask about it when you call or drop off, so there are no surprises.
- Q: ¿Hablan español?
  A: Sí. English and Spanish. Llámenos al (512) 386-6211.
- Q: Where are you and when are you open?
  A: 5211 Manor Rd, Austin, TX 78723. Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 7 PM. Closed Sunday.
